record: ICRA claim separation: what 2v2 results prove vs what SP-PPO must prove
deadline: ICRA 2027 contributed papers 2026-09-15; 8 pages incl. refs
LEAD_WITH: We use PPO to learn opponent-specific multi-robot experts, distill their behaviors into discrete modes of a shared strategy-conditioned controller, and progressively tie policy modules to identify how representation sharing affects closed-loop strategic specialization.
DO_NOT_LEAD_WITH: We created a new PPO / SP-PPO that allows latent strategies. PPO is the expert engine only; novelty is matched-state distillation + progressive sharing + closed-loop payoff validation.

METHOD_ROLES.PPO: learns the experts (standard opponent-specific multi-agent PPO)
METHOD_ROLES.matched_state_distillation: creates shared discrete strategy modes z0~pi_A, z1~pi_B
METHOD_ROLES.SP_PPO_CSC_SPFT: Claim B sealed non-recovery; appendix/tiny paragraph only

CLAIM_A_architecture_and_sharing.flagship_sentence: In 2v2, payoff-relevant strategy specialization is preserved under shared perception, begins to degrade when the policy backbone is shared, and fails once macro-action outputs are also shared.
CLAIM_A_architecture_and_sharing.robotics_takeaway: shared perception can be reused aggressively; strategy-specific higher-level action capacity is where specialization becomes fragile

CLAIM_B_algorithmic_SP_PPO.how_to_report_in_paper: One sentence or appendix: intervention family did not recover the prespecified specialization criterion. Do not attribute Share-Encoder PASS to SP-PPO.

PRIORITY_BEFORE_2026_09_15: Qualitative matched frames / optional trajectory strip
